crossRefs.note: There is no one as holy as Yahweh, for there is no one besides you, nor is there any rock like our God.
Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.
They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.
Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no…
He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.
We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and…
You shall therefore keep my statutes and my ordinances, which if a man does, he shall live in them. I am Yahweh.
I gave them my statutes, and showed them my ordinances, which if a man does, he will live in them.
Moreover also I gave them my Sabbaths, to be a sign between me and them, that they might know that I am Yahweh who…
He said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?”
For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.”
Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.”

parallels.note: Jesus said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good except one—God.
Jesus asked him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one: God.

translations.web: He said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.”
translations.bsb: “Why do you ask Me about what is good?” Jesus replied. “There is only One who is good. If you want to enter life, keep the commandments.”
translations.kjv: And he said unto him, Why callest thou me good? there is none good but one, that is, God: but if thou wilt enter into life, keep the commandments.
translations.asv: And he said unto him, Why askest thou me concerning that which is good? One there is who is good: but if thou wouldest enter into life, keep the commandments.
